paper_statement: Section 4 reports that at nonvanishing aspect ratio, existing Robust PCA and ordinary PCA fail under 5% mean-shift contamination while MS-PCA recovers the clean principal component.

tested_domain.model: one-spike Gaussian covariance plus independent rank-one Bernoulli mean shift

pass_conditions: MS-PCA mean alignment is at least 0.60 at every size
PCA mean alignment is at most 0.45 at every size and rpca==0.1.6 mean alignment is at most 0.45 on its paired n=500 subset
MS-PCA selects a stable component in at least 90% of trials at every size
paired bootstrap 95% lower bounds for MS-PCA minus both baselines exceed 0.20
MS-PCA wins at least 85% of paired trials against both baselines
independent dense eigensolver and contamination-off control pass
failure_semantics: Any unmet condition yields BLOCKED and a nonzero process exit.
